# anomaly_schedule (Data Source)

Looks up a single nxs-anomaly schedule by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing object. Alternatively, supply id instead of name.
data "anomaly_schedule" "example" {
  name = "Primary On-call"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Object ID to look up. Supply either id or the name/username lookup attribute.
- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `notify_on_shift_change` (Boolean)
- `rotation` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rotation))
- `shifts` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--shifts))
- `team_id` (String)
- `timezone` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
